provenance: Amendment No. 1 sets the 6 mm minimum lateral tie diameter. https://law.resource.org/pub/in/bis/S03/is.456.2000.pdf

method.scope: Ordinary layered rectangular web cage, zero torsion, one same-layer separated lap in the positive-moment interval of span two. The longitudinal load and path coordinates come from the frozen second-span lap.
method.compression_restraint: Check the four continuous Ø20 seats at the nominal 90-degree tie bends and the single intermediate bar between both seats in each compressed outer row. In the overlap the four-bar bottom row is in tension and the two top corners provide the compression layout. Check the physical layout, both signed transfer models and tie pitch and anchorage.
method.outputs: Use the restrained case's paths in the checked drawing and BBS. Withhold checked exports where compression restraint is missing, while retaining the signed calculations and diagnostic report.
